newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli military helicopter crashes at sea.
newsitem.headline: Israeli military helicopter crashes at sea.

text.p: An airman was killed and two were missing after an Israeli military helicopter crashed in the Mediterranean Sea during exercises, the Israeli army said on Tuesday.

The army said communications with the Dolphin type helicopter were lost around 1830 GMT on Monday. Searchers found the body of one crewman about three hours later along with the wreckage in the sea opposite the northern Israeli town of Nahariya.
The two other crewmen were missing.

Military censors, who routinely forbid publication of reports on incidents involving loss of life until the family members of the deceased are informed, barred publication of the report until Tuesday morning.
